title: Argentine cement despatches fell in August 2026
summary: Argentine cement despatches fell in August 2026
body_markdown:
**Argentina** : Total cement despatches in Argentina fell by 8% year-on-year to 817,000t in August 2026, and accumulated despatches in the first eight months of 2026 fell by 4% year-on-year to 6.32Mt. Domestic despatches fell by 8% year-on-year to 814,000t in August 2026, while exports fell to 2625t from 3541t in August 2025.


Total cement consumption fell by 8% year-on-year to 815,000t in August 2026, with accumulated consumption in the first eight months of 2026 down by 4% year-on-year to 6.29Mt. Imports fell to 220t in August 2026 from 298t in August 2025.
